purpose: Complete the Dogface automation pass on top of V65 Host / Heritage support.

source.playableDogface: Infinity RPG Corebook p.41 and Ariadna Host / Heritage data already integrated in V65

changes: Adds a Dogface-only Transform / Revert control beside Host / Heritage.
Keeps Current Form as the persisted source of truth, so browser saves and XML remain compatible.
Automatically adds innate Dogface Claws to the first free Weapon slot and removes them when Host / Heritage is no longer Dogface.
Adds the missing Fatigued condition to the master condition data and selectable condition list.
On reversion from Dog-Warrior to Human Form, automatically adds one Fatigued instance to the first free Condition slot.
When Wounds increase while a Dogface is in Human Form, prompts the player to resolve Discipline D1; a failed or voluntarily failed check transforms the character.
Dog-Warrior entry continues to restore Vigour and apply +2 Agility, +2 Brawn and +1 Vigour soak through the V65 Host modifier system.
Adds Dogface Armour Fit: Auto / Human-sized / Dogface-compatible. Auto recognises Dog-Bowl armour as compatible.
Human-sized armour in Dog-Warrior form generates the source 2+3§ transformation damage / repair warning instead of silently ignoring the rule.
Adds active form reminders for Scent, Monstrous, Snarling Beast and Super-Jump.
Synchronises app.js, data.js and the embedded single-file index.html deployment payload.
automationLimits: The sheet does not roll the Discipline D1 test; it prompts the player to resolve it and records the chosen outcome.
The sheet does not roll 2+3§ armour-transformation damage; it displays an explicit warning and repair requirement.
The sheet has two Condition slots. If both are occupied when a Dogface reverts, it warns the player to record Fatigued manually.
Vigour soak is surfaced as an active Host modifier because the sheet has no separate damage-resolution engine.
